lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular pixel clusters are distributed in distinct vertical columns; on the posterior-lateral section, these clusters form a staggered spatial arrangement with approximately equilateral relationships between adjacent nodes.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical linear bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with high-luminance circular blobs, creating a structured grid-like topology across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three dominant linear features run horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with high luminance on the dorsal edge and shadow-induced low luminance on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of several small, elongated, high-contrast shapes located along the ventral midline, exhibiting independent motion blur relative to the main body.
